title: Placeholder reviewer name in a testimonial
fix: Use the real customer's name (with consent on file) or remove the quote

title: Random stock face used as the reviewer's photo
fix: Use the customer's own photo with permission, or initials

title: Lorem-ipsum text shipped as a customer quote
fix: Replace with the customer's own words, verbatim, from your records

title: Code marks these testimonials as made-up or generated
fix: Delete them until real reviews exist; keep proof for each one you publish

title: Hard-coded aggregateRating in JSON-LD
fix: Compute ratingValue and reviewCount from the reviews actually submitted

title: Star rating typed into source next to a quote
fix: Load ratings from your review store, or keep the signed original for each

title: Static 'verified' badge not tied to an order
fix: Show the badge only when an order record for that reviewer exists

title: Reviews filtered by star rating before display
fix: Show all ratings, or filter only on neutral criteria (spam, abuse, off-topic)

title: Reward offered for a 5-star or positive review
fix: Offer the reward for any honest review, never tied to the rating

title: Relationship disclosure hidden in a hover tooltip
fix: Print the disclosure as visible text right next to the quote

title: Testimonial from your own staff or founder
fix: Add a visible disclosure next to the quote, e.g. 'Written by our employee'
